http://host:port；平台与目标不通时填。留空按环境变量: http://host:port; set this when the platform can't reach the target directly. Leave blank to use environment variables
text 模式下恒为字符串: Always a string in text mode
上面这些 cookie 拼好的 name=value; … ，可直接填进下一次请: The cookies above, already joined as name=value; …, ready to drop into the next request's Cookie header
仅 responseType=file；留空自动取名并按响应类型补后缀: Only when responseType=file; leave blank to auto-name the file and append an extension based on the response type
从本机发起出站 HTTP 请求: Makes an outbound HTTP request from this host
响应下发的全部 Set-Cookie（含重定向途中下发的）: All Set-Cookie headers returned by the response (including ones set during redirects)
响应体形状由目标接口决定：能解析成 JSON 就是结构化值，否则是原文字符串: The response body's shape depends on the target API: a structured value if it parses as JSON, otherwise the raw string
把任意 HTTP 接口变成可编排的一步。画布上有专门的「HTTP 请求」节点，: Turns any HTTP API into an orchestratable step. The canvas has a dedicated "HTTP Request" node,
按声明顺序拼进查询串: Appended to the query string in the order declared
请求体形状由目标接口决定：json 模式给对象，raw 模式给字符串: The request body's shape depends on the target API: an object in json mode, a string in raw mode
